name: Click Kahn Whip Cyan
description: JISOO 'CLICK' (Joseph Kahn, 2026-09-04): electric magenta/cyan whip-pan cover cuts on 4/4 downbeats. Hot screen-blend stacks, sharp easings, scanlines — paired with sci-fi/fairy-tale palette. Synced with paint-stroke crossfades in the spatial-zoom window.
